fields.title: Conclusion
fields.md:
1. One-sentence conclusion: The SEC filings confirmed the Round 1 baseline as is, and what has newly been settled is the definition of the GEICO combined ratio (91.4%, vs. 84.3% a year earlier) — in one year GEICO swung from a 5.2%p advantage over Progressive to a 2.7%p disadvantage (formula, Section 1).
2. Briefing in 5 lines
   - 3Q26 earnings 8-K and 10-Q posted on the SEC site (2026-11-09) — no change to baseline figures such as operating earnings of $12.705 billion and shareholders' equity of $761.368 billion ([EX-99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452530/brka-ex99_1.htm)).
   - GEICO combined ratio 91.4% (vs. 84.3% a year earlier) — definition confirmed via the formula in the SEC segment note, +2.7%p versus Progressive's 88.7% ([R110](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R110.htm)).
   - Share repurchases from 10/1 to 10/28 are back-calculated from the decline in the cover-page share count at $1.92 billion to $2.10 billion (estimate, formula in Section 2).
   - Preliminary prospectus for yen bonds in 3 tranches — purpose is refinancing a ¥96.4 billion maturity, terms not yet set ([424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452592/d86634d424b5.htm)).
   - PacifiCorp wildfire cumulative estimated loss of $2.85 billion unchanged, Oregon Supreme Court hearing the James case · sale of Washington assets for $1.9 billion expected to close in 1H 2027 ([R31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R31.htm)).
3. Three data points to check directly before the next round
   - 3Q26 13F (2026-11-16, 45-day rule formula) — the by-stock breakdown of 3Q net selling of about $430 million (Round 1 reported figure; source: [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
   - Final yen bond prospectus — whether total issuance exceeds the ¥96.4 billion being refinanced (formula, Section 3-1); if so, net borrowing rises.
   - Notice of the Oregon Supreme Court's James ruling — directly tied to E-2028-1 and R5 (source: [10-Q R31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R31.htm)).
